external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and uses applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store whose own identity provider vouches for them.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: An external identity provider that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system from which group membership and leaver changes are pulled overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: it comes from the HR system overnight

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: The broker signs colleagues in, issues tokens, signs tokens, accepts franchise identity-provider sign-in, pulls HR changes, and writes audit logs.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

processes.name: applications
processes.description: Applications take tokens and decide what colleagues may do from the groups in them.
processes.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that allows a holder of a store-manager token to change prices and void transactions.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the broker for tokens.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The broker's directory holding colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what that log records, whether it covers the franchise route, or whether the directory or the log are encrypted where they sit.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to a signed-in colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.data_description: token containing staff id and group list

data_flows.name: present token
data_flows.description: A colleague presents the issued token to an application.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.
data_flows.data_description: token containing staff id and group list

data_flows.name: use console
data_flows.description: A colleague uses the store admin console to change prices and void transactions when the token has the store-manager group.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: Applications fetch the public half of the broker's signing key.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.

data_flows.name: read signing key
data_flows.description: The broker reads the signing key it uses to sign tokens.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: pull HR changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls group-membership and leaver changes from the HR system once a night.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: update directory
data_flows.description: The broker updates its directory with colleagues and their group memberships.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague signs in through their own identity provider.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

data_flows.name: vouch for colleague
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.notes: It is not written down which colleagues that provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: It is not written down whether the audit log covers the franchise route or what the log records.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network on which the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: franchise identity provider
trust_boundaries.description: The zone controlled by the franchise identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

assumptions.assumption: The directory's contents are confidential because it holds colleagues and their group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory keeps colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's contents are confidential because it holds signing keys and credentials.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the broker keeps a signing key in the key store.

assumptions.assumption: The audit log's contents are confidential because it records sign-ins associated with colleagues.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
